subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers adopt the open cross-repository fix PR, ask the contributor to make it editable/update it, or close it and authorize a narrow replacement PR?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but an open unmerged PR with closing syntax already exists and `maintainerCanModify` is false, so automation should not create a duplicate branch without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt or replace the linked fix
options.body: Use the open PR as source work if it can be updated safely, or close it after opening a narrow maintainer-owned replacement with equivalent credit.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep the issue and linked PR open while asking the contributor to enable maintainer edits and add the missing upgrade/test proof.

options.title: Defer the cron stagger fix
options.body: Keep the issue open without new repair work, accepting that step/list/range minute-zero schedules remain unstaggered for now.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the linked fix
recommendation.body: Use the open PR as source work if it can be updated safely, or close it after opening a narrow maintainer-owned replacement with equivalent credit.

likelyOwner.reason: The default stagger helper and service integration appear to originate from Peter Steinberger's commit, making him the clearest available routing owner for the behavior decision.
